identity_reason: an icon is a glyph at one of two sizes in the text colour, so it has no form of its own
concept: A glyph at one of the two icon sizes, in the colour of the text beside it, decorative unless it is named.

root.why: sits on the text line and inherits the text colour so it reads with its label

sm.why: the 16px icon step for dense rows and inline with small text

md.why: the 18px icon step, the default beside body text and in buttons

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the glyph takes the system text colour so it never disappears
